We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer to help design, develop, and maintain secure and scalable web applications. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding the existing application, communicating with clients to understand their requirements, developing new functionalities, and providing resolutions for issues. You will play a crucial role in the full development lifecycle, ensuring seamless integration, optimization, and troubleshooting of our application solutions.


Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities





Conduct detailed analysis the 8 business applications and 8 internal tooling applications hosted on Google Kubernetes Engine(GKE)

Analysis of the backend stack developed on REST API and integration for the applications.

Analyze data sources and different types of data associated with the applications on Google Kubernetes Engine(GKE)

Analyze Client's deployment strategy on Kubernetes Platform using ArgoCDs.

Design an end-state architecture taking into consideration the AWS best Practices built around five pillars (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency and Cost Optimisation)

Design a Migration Development roadmap and strategy to lift and shift the applications hosted on GKE to AWS EKS and associated PostgreSQL Databases

5+ years of working experience in designing and implementing web applications on the AWS platform. Well versed with microservice architecture, cloud-based web services architecture, design patterns and frameworks.

Strong experience in Ruby on Rails, API design and architecture design.

Ability to lead the technical solution development from scratch and to lead a team of developers in the implementation.

Knowledge of GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine) and migration to AWS EKS for containerized workloads/applications.

Experience in designing application migration roadmap plans and implementation strategy

- Role : Software Engineer – Ruby (Remote) 
- Location : Remote (Work from Anywhere) 

Role Overview: 

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Ruby (LLM Evaluation & Repository Validation) to work on a Full-Time basis. The projects focus on building LLM evaluation and training datasets that address realistic software engineering problems. One approach involves creating verifiable software engineering tasks from public repository histories using a synthetic method with human‑in‑the‑loop, while expanding coverage across programming languages and difficulty levels. 

Key Responsibilities: 

• Analyze and triage GitHub issues across trending open‑source libraries to identify suitable evaluation scenarios. 

• Set up and configure code repositories, including Docker containerization and environment preparation for reproducible testing. 

• Evaluate unit test coverage and quality metrics to assess baseline code health and test suite robustness. 

• Modify and run Ruby codebases locally to measure LLM performance in bug‑fixing and code‑completion tasks. 

• Collaborate with AI researchers to design and select repositories and issues that present challenging cases for LLMs. 

Required Skills & Qualifications: 

• Minimum three years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Ruby and Ruby on Rails. 

• Demonstrated expertise with Git, Docker, and basic software pipeline setup for reproducible testing. 

• Ability to navigate and understand complex, real‑world codebases, and to run, modify, and test them locally. 

• Experience with Ruby testing frameworks (RSpec, Minitest), gem management (Bundler), and code quality tooling. 

• Prior contribution to or evaluation of open‑source projects is considered a plus. 

More About the Prospect: 

This role provides a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the artificial intelligence industry, contributing to how large language models interact with real code. The work directly influences the development of AI‑assisted software development tools and benchmarks. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. 

Apply Now!

jobs.title: Ruby on Rails Engineer (Hybrid Bangalore)
jobs.description:
Commutatus partners with ambitious entrepreneurs, startups, and corporates in various industries to conceptualise, design, and build digital products. We are the team that companies like [AIESEC (https://aiesec.org/)], [Rajasthan Royals (https://www.rajasthanroyals.com/)], [Brevo (https://www.brevo.com/)], [Gehna (https://www.uddhavalogistics.com/)], [NADIM (https://nadim.org/)], and [others (https://www.commutatus.com/clients)] hire to get things done.


Over the past years, we've gained substantial experience building platforms the right way. The platforms we build now are both super malleable and easy to scale. Our vision at Commutatus is to bring tomorrow closer to today, and we aspire to do so for multiple clients simultaneously.


Take a look at why you should work here! We've recorded a video to provide you with a quick overview of who we are and what we aim to achieve with this role. [Watch (https://youtu.be/8on6KUoFRAk)] it.


What would you do at Commutatus?


You'll primarily work in a squad of 6-8 people, comprising designers, front-end engineers, back-end engineers, and a project manager. Your responsibilities will include -


Research and feasibility checks: Assist in ideating features by providing inputs based on research or your experience. You'll frequently advise the team on the feasibility of ideas and provide alternative routes to meet the feature's objective.


Planning and estimation: You will assist the squad in planning and estimating features to ensure they roll out on time and function as expected.


Framework Development: Your work will power the backbone of our platform. You'll build frameworks, such as file exports and rate limiting, that roll out to 50+ platforms through gem updates, shaping how thousands of users experience our products.


Framework Implementation: Your work will directly impact clients across industries. In just a week, you could streamline inventory for an e-commerce brand or launch a course manager for an EdTech startup—all through our Platform Gem and GraphQL APIs.


Continuous improvement: Play an active role in team retrospective events by flagging problems and frustrations in the team and offering solutions.


What you need to have: We are not big on credentials. A computer science degree or graduation from a prestigious university is not something we spend much time considering. We care about what you can do and how you do it, not how you got there.


Absolute Requirements



You have exceptional communication skills.
You are resourceful - we don't expect you to know all the answers right away, but we want you to research and learn on the go to get the job done right.
You can identify problems around you and independently propose solutions to these problems. We love independent problem-solvers and encourage all our employees to suggest changes to streamline our processes.
You are organised and structured. Your PRs are well-structured, have excellent descriptions, and your JIRA tickets are always in the right status. You demonstrate a strong understanding of Ruby on Rails, APIs, and database design.
Skills and experiences we'd like to see


You've built scalable digital platforms before that have been deployed to production environments.
You know how GraphQL and REST APIs work, i.e., how to build, maintain, and improve them.
You have designed databases and optimised their performance.
You understand the various components of a backend system, including app servers, databases, and caches.
You've contributed to open source, built developer tools or plugins
You have a sound understanding of deploying apps to staging or production via automated tools such as GitHub Actions.
What we can give you


The freedom to learn and grow in the company.
A supportive team who'll help you when you are stuck!
A learning path, feedback, and resources to take you to the next step in your technical career! We even sponsor certifications and tickets to select tech events!
A safe space to explore your varied interests.
A platform to explore and understand different domains.
An invested interest in your well-being. All our employees benefit from generous health insurance.
The space for you to have a healthy work-life balance.
Reality check


These preliminary questions will help you determine if you meet our requirements.


Do you love freedom and flexibility in your work?
Do you seek out opportunities and learn something new each day?
Are you a great communicator?
Do you ensure quality on everything you ship out so you are proud to have your stamp on it?
If you align with everything we've said, we are interested!
